acceptance_criteria.criterion: rest-api.md documents ErrorSeverity as 'error' | 'warning' | 'audit' | 'info' and the GET /api/error-log severity filter accepts all four values.
rest-api.md no longer contains a note about credential-audit entries using Severity: 'warning' as a workaround.
constraints.md documents the expanded ErrorSeverity type and no longer contains the "consumers must trim before use" note for parseGitCredentials().
api-surface.md documents the expanded ErrorSeverity type and describes the stale badge resolution mechanism in checkWorkspaceHealth().
gui-frontend.md documents the "Audit" and "Info" severity filter options, .severity-audit and .severity-info CSS classes, and the "Configure" button in the health alert section.
data-flows.md documents the credential success log entry flow (successful clone → Source: 'credentials', Severity: 'info' entry → stale badge suppression).
src/config/README.md notes that parseGitCredentials() trims all fields at parse time.
src/server/README.md references Severity: 'audit' for credential audit logging.
.context/ files are regenerated and up to date.

summary: Updated all project documentation to reflect WP-001 through WP-007 changes. Two files required active edits; the remaining AC-referenced files were already up to date from prior WP implementations. CTX files regenerated successfully (31 documents, zero errors).
